# QYL0006: Schema URL stored as a resource attribute

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Severity | Info |

| Analyzer | `Qyl0006SchemaUrlAttributeAnalyzer` |

## Description

A telemetry.schema_url resource attribute does not set resource schema metadata. Supply a known schema through the SDK schemaUrl parameter; leave unknown schemas unset.
